title: Five-Word Joint BiGAN 4k Retention Hold
intuition: Continues the candidate's earliest passing `five_word_joint_smoke` checkpoint for 4,000 updates, requiring every single scheduled generation and inverse-reconstruction check to stay passing without drift.
failure_mode: Even after clean acquisition, coupled BiGAN minimax dynamics gradually rotate or collapse latent word codes, causing late-window reconstruction drop or mode loss.
protocol_notes: Tier-2 required continuation of `five_word_joint_smoke` (4,000 updates; strict every-check retention).
